name: category_tree
note: ProductCategory parent_store (parent_id, parent_path) and removal_strategy_id read at stock/models/stock_quant.py:653: the whole tree by id
source_sql: SELECT id, parent_id, parent_path, removal_strategy_id, company_id FROM product_category ORDER BY id

name: picking_types_per_category
note: product.category.picking_type_ids (embedded stockPickingTypeRel[], junction into stockPickingType): linked picking types per category
source_sql: SELECT pc.id AS category_id, count(rel.stock_picking_type_id) AS picking_types FROM product_category pc LEFT JOIN product_category_stock_picking_type_rel rel ON rel.product_category_id = pc.id GROUP BY pc.id ORDER BY pc.id
